title: M4 Pro vs M5 Pro: One Number Decides (374 tok/s Prefill)
description: MoEShift's author benchmarked the same 125B MoE model on 24 GB M4 Pro and M5 Pro MacBooks: 199 vs 374 tok/s prefill, and the gap is the wait before the first word.
hook_text: M4 Pro or M5 Pro? One number.
hook_candidates: M4 Pro or M5 Pro? One number decides.
Three hundred seventy four tokens a second, and not one is the answer.
Your Mac reads the prompt fast. Writing the answer is the slow part.
A 125 billion parameter model on a 24 GB Mac, at 8.5 GB of RAM.
Same model, same quant, same memory. Double the speed.
The new MacBook's SSD just doubled your prefill.
199 versus 374. The chip didn't get twice as fast.
You paste a long document. The cursor blinks. That's prefill.
The wait before the first word is the benchmark nobody runs.
Faster storage, not a faster GPU, moved this number.
narration_full: M four Pro or M five Pro? One number decides. Three hundred seventy four tokens a second, your tiebreaker. Prefill: your pasted document, read before the first word appears. The runtime's own benchmark: eighty three point nine seconds on M four Pro. M five Pro: fifty five point one. Prefill made the gap: one hundred ninety nine on M four Pro, three hundred seventy four on M five Pro. Its author credits the SSD, not the GPU. The same giant model fits either chip. The catch: answers still type out in no hurry. First-word upgrade, not chat-speed. Long documents make the M five Pro your chip; short prompts run fine on either.
